title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.06282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. translated_title: MonoLaDN：面向单目3D目标检测的语言引导去噪方法
translated_abstract: 单目3D目标检测为3D感知提供了一种低成本的途径，但由于深度必须从单一视角进行推断，这本质上是一个病态问题。近期基于Transformer的检测器仅从图像特征和3D框标注中学习几何信息，缺乏视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过大规模预训练所获得的高层语义先验。VLM虽然能够提供此类先验，但由于其高昂的推理成本，直接将其部署为检测器并不现实。我们提出了MonoLaDN，这是一种语言引导的去噪框架，能够将VLM的几何推理能力迁移到单目3D检测器中，同时保持部署的模型纯粹基于视觉。在训练过程中，一个冻结的VLM根据图像及其真值框，对每个目标的遮挡、深度、尺寸和角度生成结构化推理。我们将这些推理编码为查询，通过添加噪声进行扰动，并训练检测器重建干净的查询（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: MonoLaDN在训练阶段利用冻结的视觉-语言模型生成关于目标遮挡、深度、尺寸和角度的结构化几何推理，并通过语言引导的去噪策略将其几何先验迁移到单目3D检测器中，部署时模型保持纯视觉推理，无需承担VLM的高昂推理成本。
en_tdlr: MonoLaDN transfers geometric reasoning from a frozen vision-language model into a monocular 3D detector through language-guided denoising during training, enabling purely vision-based deployment without the costly VLM inference.
